summary: __thiscall initializer that runs StructInitializer on five consecutive 0x40-byte sub-structures starting at this[6] and advancing by 16 dwords, then zeroes the three DWORD fields at byte offsets 0xC, 0x10 and 0x14, then calls UIComponentCleanup(this) and returns this. Called during physics tire system construction.

operations.description: Five-iteration loop: start the element pointer at this[6] (dword index) and advance it by 16 dwords (0x40 bytes) per iteration, seeded with a count of 5.
Call StructInitializer on each sub-structure pointer v2 inside the loop body.
Zero the field at this[3] (byte offset 0xC).
Zero the field at this[4] (byte offset 0x10).
Zero the field at this[5] (byte offset 0x14).
Call UIComponentCleanup(this) after the sub-structure and field initialization.
Invoked by PhysicsTireSystemConstructor (0x004E4500) as part of physics tire system construction.

unresolved: Object/class identity is unknown; caller relationship places it in the physics tire system.
Meaning of the three zeroed DWORD fields (0xC, 0x10, 0x14) is unknown.
Whether UIComponentCleanup here is a true destructor hook or a generic teardown helper is unknown.
